name: Grilled Ahi Tuna Steak (Plain Sear Mod)

prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the tuna steak seared plain with olive oil/butter and served with mashed potatoes or steamed white rice instead of the eggplant caponata, sun-dried tomato pesto, and skin-on fingerling potatoes.
watchOuts: Eggplant caponata and sun-dried tomato skins
